opportunities.title: Opportunity Radar
opportunities.intro: Review opportunity-related signals already collected by your monitoring. Matches are explainable keyword overlaps, not confirmation that a program is open or that you qualify.
opportunities.profileHelp: Use terms that describe your organization and priorities. This profile is private to your organization and only ranks existing signals.
opportunities.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
opportunities.signalsHelp: Existing monitoring matches that were classified as opportunity-related.
opportunities.empty: No matching signals are currently available. Keep monitoring active or adjust your themes.
opportunities.setupFirst: Save an organization profile to explain and rank your opportunity signals.
opportunities.themeReason: The stored headline or excerpt mentions “{theme}”.
opportunities.noThemeMatch: No target profile term appears in the stored headline or excerpt.
opportunities.checkOpenStatus: Check whether the opportunity is still open.
opportunities.checkPublisherTerms: Check the publisher's eligibility rules, amount, and deadline; this match does not infer them.
opportunities.checkConstraint: Verify this constraint with the publisher: {constraint}.
opportunities.verifiedByTeam: Marked as checked by your team
opportunities.teamCheckedSource: Our team checked the publisher page
